reports.text: New arrivals registered at the Tawila reception point; families report leaving villages west of El Fasher after attacks.
Water points at Tawila camp over capacity; shelter kits given to first 120 households, remaining stock low.
Shelling reported in southern neighbourhoods; access to two clinics interrupted.
Families leaving outer neighbourhoods toward Tawila road.
Seasonal wadi flooding damaged two water points; no displacement reported.
Sorghum and millet prices up roughly 15 percent versus last month.
Suspected cholera cases reported at the health facility; samples sent for testing.
Smoke and burning reported at farms on the town periphery.
Small group of families arrived from rural areas; no urgent needs flagged.
Ongoing cross-border movement; transit centre at about 80 percent capacity.
